messages:
Aisha: deploybot starting staged enable for model mosaic-7b-quant-v3 -> 10% traffic (canaries: us-east-1, ap-southeast-1). change window 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. tagging @SRE and @DevOps for ops checks

deploy-bot: [deploybot] 6123456789 - catalog.enable mosaic-7b-quant-v3 -> 10% canary | regions: us-east-1, ap-southeast-1 | rollout_id=roll-6123 :rocket:

Lukas: quick perf note: ap-southeast-1 shows a 3% increase in application errors with long inputs (>2048 tokens). not yet sure if it's model or infra.

SRE: looking. traces show increased grpc retries and a worker restarting loop on a small subset of hosts in ap-southeast-1. suspect quant kernel memory pressure. collecting core dumps and GPU mem stats now.

QA: reproduced with a long convo prompt locally against quant-v3, see higher token loss and occasional decoding timeouts. adding a failing prompt to the eval set.

Aisha: proposal: pause ap-southeast-1 canary, revert region fallback to mosaic-7b-fp16, keep us-east-1 running. prefer region-scoped pause so rollout_id roll-6123 remains continuous.

DevOps: I'll run the region patch. command: ```./deployctl catalog patch --model mosaic-7b-quant-v3 --region ap-southeast-1 --action pause --fallback mosaic-7b-fp16 --note "long-input errors"```

deploy-bot: ack. 6123456796 - patch applied. ap-southeast-1 -> fallback=mosaic-7b-fp16. rollout_id=roll-6123 :white_check_mark:

Product: please add to release notes that APAC will remain on fp16 while we validate quant changes. we need to communicate to partners if customer-facing behavior differs.

Aisha: noted. I'll update internal changelog + release notes. adding config diff and the rollout_id to the note.

Lukas: longer-term idea: add a fallback-weighting knob so we can route 1% of APAC traffic to a safer quantized microvariant (mosaic-7b-quant-safe) for smoke testing without full enable. low-risk probing.

SRE: +1. For immediate ops, recommend retaining a 5-minute observation gate and an automated rollback threshold: if error_rate_apac > 2.5% for 15m -> rollback to fp16 and open incident.

DevOps: monitoring updated and an alert rule created. dashboard snapshot: https://metrics.redwood/internal/dashboards/roll-6123?from=6123456789&to=6123456860

QA: pushed failing prompt set to the eval harness: https://ci.redwood/tests/roll-6123-eval. tagging @Aisha.

Aisha: decision: hold ap-southeast-1 paused. continue observing us-east-1 for 30m. if us-east-1 shows no regression we'll proceed with staggered expansion (10% -> 20% -> 40%) with 10m gates. if errors surface, full rollback plan is to revert the catalog pin to mosaic-7b-fp16 and notify customers.

Product: drafting a short customer bulletin in case we need to expand the pause. will have an internal comms blurb ready.

Lukas: thanks. I'll start a follow-up ticket to add fallback-weighting and quant-safe variant to catalog metadata.

SRE: collecting artifacts. will attach traces and node dumps to the incident stub if we hit the rollback threshold.

Aisha: thanks everyone. I'll post a 30m update with roll vs rollback recommendation.
